recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If the March 2024 usage guidance is still desired, add it to the patient-unknownIdentity extension narrative/definition in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than duplicating prose in core.
issue_request: The Applied/Persuasive PA issue requested a standard Patient extension for PID-31 identity unknown, resolved as a 0..1 CodeableConcept extension with an extensible known/unknown value set and later PA usage guidance about identity verification examples.
initial_application: The semantic artifacts were applied in the FHIR Extension Pack by commit a680ebb0b2d661c6ee4ec61bf7f4e34047709fc3, which added StructureDefinition-patient-unknownIdentity.xml, CodeSystem-patient-unknownIdentity.xml, and ValueSet-patient-unknownIdentity.xml. Core later gained matching OID registry entries in source/oids.ini via bfb362f11250684baf6710d3a95ca5ddd1f7c4a0 but does not contain the extension definition source.
additional_context: The current extension-pack StructureDefinition is scoped to Patient, uses CodeableConcept, requires a value, and binds extensibly to the patient-unknownIdentity value set; its CodeSystem defines known and unknown codes. March 2024 PA Jira comments, minutes, and Zulip discussion added usage guidance about identity verification that is not present in the current extension-pack definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core source change was made because the authoritative extension definition and the remaining candidate usage guidance belong in HL7/fhir-extensions, not this core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Extension Pack cleanup later made patient-unknownIdentity terminology artifacts non-experimental, confirming continuing external-pack ownership without changing the FHIR-31505 known/unknown semantics.
